variants.use: Use the reviewed glossary consistently for the same concept across screens and resource keys.

android-implementation|How to build.summary: W15B native implementation and web-package boundaries; browser adapters and web linters remain web tooling.

variants.name: W15B: Platforms standard
variants.compose: Use generated tokens with Material layout, navigation and semantics.
variants.views: Use generated resources with Android layouts, navigation and accessibility semantics.
variants.use: Use the existing platform standard and generated tokens; retain native layout, navigation and input behavior.

variants.name: W15B: Mobile web
variants.compose: For hosted web content, test responsive behavior in WebView; native screens use Material window insets.
variants.views: Test WebView viewport and touch behavior separately from native view layouts.
variants.use: This is browser implementation guidance, not a native adapter; validate narrow layouts and touch input in the actual browser.

variants.name: W15B: Desktop
variants.compose: Support keyboard traversal and adaptive window sizing without copying fixed desktop dimensions.
variants.views: Test hardware keyboard traversal, focus restoration and resizable Android windows.
variants.use: Keep desktop keyboard operation, focus restoration and resizable layouts distinct from narrow-screen behavior.

variants.name: W15B: Native implementation
variants.compose: Consume generated Kotlin tokens with Compose and Material controls.
variants.views: Consume generated Android resources with native views and platform accessibility APIs.
variants.use: Generate tokens through the existing build; use platform controls and additive native guidance instead of browser wrappers.

variants.name: W15B: Browser support policy
variants.compose: Evaluate capability checks inside WebView and test the supported engine versions.
variants.views: Do not infer WebView capability from Android API level; test hosted web content.
variants.use: Browser queries and capability fallbacks apply to web builds only; browser engines inside native hosts need separate testing.

variants.name: W15B: Vue
variants.compose: Use Compose for native screens; Vue runs only as web content in a WebView.
variants.views: Use Android views for native screens; the Vue adapter is a browser integration.
variants.use: The Vue package mounts the React web runtime; it does not create native controls or replace native token builds.

variants.name: W15B: Lint tooling
variants.compose: Run Kotlin and Android checks for Compose; web lint does not inspect Kotlin semantics.
variants.views: Run Android lint, resource checks and accessibility review separately from web CSS and JavaScript lint.
variants.use: ESLint and Stylelint check web JavaScript and CSS; native compiler and accessibility checks remain separate.
